sources: Rams.com injury updates and FantasyPros player news, Aug. 24-29
Commanders.com practice and preseason availability reports, Aug. 26-28
meta.note: Aug. 30 refresh: preserve the master Top-150 rankings; this file remains a news/role patch. Jeanty is 'on the mend' with no detailed timetable, so his long-term value remains intact but Week 1 stays a watch. Puka Nacua is still working back from psoas/groin soreness and remained out of team work late in the week, increasing short-term risk without changing elite-season upside. Malik Nabers shed the non-contact jersey and the Giants said a late-week concern was not injury-related; Week 1 trajectory improved. Jacory Croskey-Merritt remained out late in camp and Rachaad White also did not play in the finale, keeping Washington's backfield unsettled. Jonathon Brooks completed preseason work successfully; Chuba Hubbard's hamstring remains the variable for early usage.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.notes: Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Jeanty is 'on the mend.' No detailed timetable was given. Treat Week 1 as a watch, but there is no evidence of a long-term workload reduction.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.notes: High-ankle sprain; out rest of preseason and could start slowly even if active Week 1.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.notes: Shed the red non-contact jersey and moved well in team work. John Harbaugh said a late-week concern was not injury-related and that Nabers is physically fine. Week 1 outlook continues to improve.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.notes: Still a breakout target, but Tyler Biadasz is out for the year and Keaton Mitchell is solidifying RB2 work.

players.name: Bhayshul Tuten
players.notes: Jacksonville backfield looks committee-like; Chris Rodriguez has a legitimate lead-role case.

players.name: George Kittle
players.notes: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab; Week 1 outlook improved.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.notes: Preseason usage points to clear RB2 role behind Hampton; committee upside if role expands.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.notes: Successfully returned to game action during the preseason and was rested with starters in the finale. Early-season workload still depends partly on Chuba Hubbard's hamstring status, but Brooks' health trend is positive.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.notes: Hamstring injury was described as week-to-week earlier in camp. Carolina hoped for Week 1 readiness, but early-season workload remains a health watch alongside Jonathon Brooks.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.notes: Still missed late-camp work and was held out of the preseason finale. Washington's backfield remains unsettled, with Rachaad White also sidelined and other backs getting first-team carries.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.notes: Also held out of the preseason finale after missing practice time. His health and the split with Jacory Croskey-Merritt remain unclear, so treat him as a late-round role bet rather than a stable starter.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.notes: Alvin Kamara is expected to miss 4-6 weeks with an MCL sprain, strengthening Etienne’s early-season workload and touchdown outlook.

players.name: Kendre Miller
players.notes: Healthy and positioned for increased early-season work behind Travis Etienne while Alvin Kamara recovers from an MCL sprain.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.notes: Still working back from psoas/groin soreness and remained out of team/joint-practice work late in the week. Elite season-long ceiling remains, but the extended absence adds short-term injury uncertainty.

rbCore.name: Ashton Jeanty
rbCore.label: ON THE MEND / WEEK 1 WATCH
rbCore.note: Klint Kubiak said Jeanty is 'on the mend' but gave no detailed timetable. Long-term workload projection stays elite; Week 1 remains the main uncertainty.

rbCore.name: Omarion Hampton
rbCore.label: TARGET — DOWN A NOTCH
rbCore.note: Still a breakout target, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season and Keaton Mitchell is emerging as the clear RB2.

rbBackup.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rbBackup.label: PREMIUM JEANTY CONTINGENCY
rbBackup.note: Washington handled first-team reps after Jeanty's injury and remains the preferred contingency. Jeanty is now described as 'on the mend,' so Washington's standalone Week 1 probability is lower than it was immediately after the injury.

rbBackup.name: Tyler Allgeier
rbBackup.label: IMMEDIATE EARLY-SEASON UPSIDE
rbBackup.note: Jeremiyah Love is out the rest of preseason with a high-ankle sprain. Allgeier is the favorite to lead if Love misses Week 1 or is eased back.

rbBackup.name: Keaton Mitchell
rbBackup.label: CLEAR RB2 / ROLE GROWTH
rbBackup.note: Preseason usage indicates Mitchell is solidifying the RB2 job and could form more of a two-man rotation with Hampton than previously expected.

rbBackup.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
rbBackup.label: JAGUARS ROLE CHALLENGER
rbBackup.note: Jacksonville appears headed toward a committee, and Rodriguez has a legitimate early-down/short-yardage case against Bhayshul Tuten.

rbBackup.name: Jonathon Brooks
rbBackup.label: HEALTH TREND UP / COMMITTEE UPSIDE
rbBackup.note: Brooks completed preseason game work successfully and was later rested with starters. Chuba Hubbard's hamstring still shapes the opening split, but Brooks' health trend is increasingly positive.

rbBackup.name: Kendre Miller
rbBackup.label: KAMARA ABSENCE BOOST
rbBackup.note: Kamara is expected out 4-6 weeks. Miller has stayed healthy through recent work and can earn meaningful complementary touches behind Travis Etienne.

rbBackup.name: Rachaad White
rbBackup.label: WASHINGTON BACKFIELD STILL MURKY
rbBackup.note: White remained out late in camp and did not play in the preseason finale. Jacory Croskey-Merritt was also out, leaving the early-season workload distribution unresolved.

wrCore.name: Puka Nacua
wrCore.label: ELITE — INJURY WATCH
wrCore.note: Still absent from team work late in the week because of psoas/groin soreness. Do not downgrade the season-long ceiling materially, but account for increased short-term durability risk at 1.04.

wrCore.name: Malik Nabers
wrCore.label: WEEK 1 TRENDING UP
wrCore.note: Nabers shed the red non-contact jersey and moved well. Harbaugh said a late-week issue was not injury-related and that Nabers is physically fine. ACL recovery remains the background risk, but the trend is favorable.

wrCore.name: DeVonta Smith
wrCore.label: ROLE EXPANSION
wrCore.note: Returned to full practice and still has a clearer path to career-high volume after A.J. Brown’s departure.

qbCore.name: Justin Herbert
qbCore.label: FORMAT VALUE / OL WATCH
qbCore.note: Five-point passing TDs still help, but center Tyler Biadasz is out for the season, reducing the offensive-line improvement case.

teCore.name: George Kittle
teCore.label: REHAB TRENDING UP
teCore.note: Returned to practice from Achilles rehab. Age still matters, but availability outlook improved materially.
